=== Current paternal evidence ===
The father relationship to [[Glasgow-81]] is assessed at 80% (probable). The Ancestry Scotland, Select Births and Baptisms index entry for Margaret Glasgow, 13 December 1753 at West Calder (https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60143/records/12992896), reads the parent fields that the previous review could not see: father John and mother Magdalene (forenames only). This is the John Glasgow and Magdalene Guthrie household of West Calder already attached as John [[Glasgow-81]]; with the parent clause now read, the child-to-household link is no longer an inherited placement. Confidence rises to 80%.

The Ancestry Scotland, Select Births and Baptisms rows are Ancestry's copy of the FamilySearch Scotland Births and Baptisms index already cited, so they verify the indexed parent fields rather than adding an independent source; the original register is uninspected. The index row gives the mother's forename only. John-81's own identification with the Kirknewton child of about 1709 and his father link (Andrew-1546) are separate and unchanged. No mother change follows.
